comparison.objective: Fit a long kerf-in weatherstrip into a door jamb with both ends flush.
comparison.physical_skill: Long deformable-strip alignment and progressive barbed-fin insertion without bunching or stretch.
comparison.success_condition: Entire fin ≥8 mm into kerf, both ends within 2 mm, hands clear and strip still for 1 s.
comparison.reason: Tests distributed deformable insertion along a slot, not rigid many-body selection through apertures.
